summary: Lantern Pharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered follow-on offering of 1,469,725 common shares at $1.09 per share plus 2,200,000 pre-funded warrants at $1.0899, alongside a concurrent private placement of purchase warrants for up to 3,669,725 shares at $1.09, exercisable only after shareholder approval. The pricing matches the September 28, 2026 last sale of $1.09. Rodman Renshaw acts as exclusive placement agent on a best-efforts basis with no minimum or escrow. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation; watch warrant approval timing and potential dilution overhang.
